title: Device & browser pass
runtimeProof: Representative journeys have no document/body horizontal overflow across all five target viewports.
320px and 390px mobile navigation and search popovers stay inside the viewport.
The Statistics dense table remains locally horizontally scrollable and keyboard-scrollable at 320px without widening the page.
Featured Reports respects prefers-reduced-motion by removing the autoplay control.
The civic-map iframe accepts keyboard focus and retains a text fallback.
200% text resizing does not create page-level overflow on the homepage, Search, Services or Calendar.
The accessibility suite covers 51 representative substantive routes with WCAG 2.0/2.1 A-AA and axe-core WCAG 2.2 AA tags and rejects serious/critical findings.
fixesVerified: Statistics narrow-card reflow and scroll-region containment
Main shell min-width containment for locally scrollable content

bounded.reason: CI browser proof is Chromium on Ubuntu; Firefox, WebKit/Safari and physical-device rendering are not claimed.
Automated browser and Axe coverage do not replace manual assistive-technology and physical-device sampling.
Passing automated checks and the W6-5 matrix support the WCAG 2.2 AA target but do not constitute a formal conformance claim.
